name: Alcaldía de Manizales
body: A declared language, a canonical, a sitemap named in robots.txt, and a 301 to https. But real Chrome visitors wait 5.7 s at the 75th percentile for the largest content, and the HTML alone took 2.5 s.
lesson: Start with the server: cache the HTML. Then preload the hero image and defer scripts that aren't needed.
summary: manizales.gov.co scores 70 out of 100 (C). 4 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 12 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 15 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 16 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /accesibilidad/, /transparencia-y-acceso-informacion-publica/, /atencion-ciudadania/ and 11 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 15 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 15 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /accesibilidad/, /transparencia-y-acceso-informacion-publica/, /atencion-ciudadania/ and 11 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 15 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 61 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page sets a mobile viewport
The start page reads well without JavaScript
